title: How MFPI's pregame rankings fared: Weeks 1-7 rankings against the games that followed
dek: The higher-rated team won 540 of 701 games between ranked MHSAA teams (77.0%), using only the rankings published before kickoff.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Only games between two ranked MHSAA teams are evaluated.
Uses the rankings actually published before kickoff; no hindsight inputs.

sections.heading: What was measured
paragraphs: For every game between two ranked MHSAA teams, the favorite is the team with the higher full-precision MFPI in the latest snapshot published before that game's date, including an audited correction if one was issued before kickoff. Later rankings and later corrections are never used to pick a favorite.

A game counts as correct when the favorite won. Results are the verified final scores in the Week 8 snapshot. MFPI is a rating of past performance, not a betting line: home field, injuries and weather are not considered, and no point spread is implied.

Excluded and disclosed below: games against non-MHSAA or out-of-state opponents (they have no MFPI rating), games where both teams had exactly equal ratings, tied games, and games involving a team credited with two games on the same date (a listing under review).

sections.heading: Results by ranking week
paragraphs: Across these windows the favorite won 540 of 701 (77.0%). The Week 1 ranking was built from about one game per team plus the fading classification prior; the table shows each week's rate as published.

sections.heading: Bigger rating gaps were more reliable
paragraphs: Games grouped by the pregame MFPI gap between the two teams.

sections.heading: Largest upsets by pregame rating gap
paragraphs: [[callaway]] beat [[terry]] 7-6 on Sep 18, overcoming a 47.1-point gap in the Week 3 ranking.
[[kossuth]] beat [[tishomingo-county]] 31-13 on Sep 11, overcoming a 45.2-point gap in the Week 2 ranking.
[[long-beach]] beat [[gautier]] 16-14 on Oct 8, overcoming a 38.1-point gap in the Week 6 ranking.
[[amanda-elzy]] beat [[north-pontotoc]] 20-14 on Sep 18, overcoming a 36.9-point gap in the Week 3 ranking.
[[saltillo]] beat [[olive-branch]] 26-21 on Oct 9, overcoming a 35.3-point gap in the Week 6 ranking.

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated October 20, 2026 at 11:20 AM Central with a cutoff of October 20 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
871 of 892 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (97.7%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
Formula versions differed across these weeks (MFPI-3.0 to MFPI-3.2); each ranking is evaluated as it was published.
Samples are small (701 games); a few results can move these percentages several points.
